record.summary: The digital-cooperation annex (annex I) of the Pact for the Future. Its fifth objective, international governance of artificial intelligence for the benefit of humanity, calls for a balanced, inclusive and risk-based approach and for transparency, accountability and robust human oversight of AI systems. Member States commit to establish within the UN an Independent International Scientific Panel on AI, for evidence-based impact, risk and opportunity assessments, and to initiate a Global Dialogue on AI Governance. Standards bodies are asked for interoperable AI standards that uphold safety, reliability and human rights, and AI capacity-building in developing countries is to be supported.
record.notes: Adopted at the Summit of the Future on 22 September 2024. Resolution 79/1 contains the Pact for the Future with two annexes, the Global Digital Compact (annex I) and the Declaration on Future Generations; the Compact's text was circulated before adoption as part of draft A/79/L.2. The terms of reference of the Scientific Panel and the Global Dialogue that the Compact committed to were set by General Assembly resolution 79/325 of 26 August 2025 (UN-07). The Compact provides for a high-level review during the General Assembly's 82nd session.

verification.note: Stored in this run, all from un.org: the Summit of the Future's page on the Pact, which gives the adoption on 22 September 2024, the symbol A/RES/79/1 and the two annexes, and is proposed as the new official_url because the UN Digital Library record returns a bot-check page; the published outcome documents (PDF, 'September 2024'), whose contents list 'Annex I: Global Digital Compact'; and A/RES/79/325, which recalls resolution 79/1 of 22 September 2024 and its annex I, the Global Digital Compact. The record's secondary source is the Compact's English text as circulated in draft A/79/L.2 (un.org PDF); the summary is written from its objective 5 (paragraphs 50 to 63), which the adopted outcome documents repeat (pages 53 to 55). The meeting number and the manner of adoption given in version 1 are not shown by any stored file and were removed from the notes.

judgment.status_reasoning: Adopted at the Summit of the Future on 22 September 2024 (Summit page) and published as the outcome documents in September 2024. Resolution 79/325 of 26 August 2025 recalls it and implements its AI commitments; the Compact provides for a high-level review at the 82nd session (para. 74) and nothing stored replaces it. A declaratory compact of commitments, so 'Published (non-binding, current)' and 'Non-binding' stand.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A General Assembly resolution whose AI objective sets up the UN's AI risk-assessment panel and governance dialogue; in scope with no note.
